name: RNA Toxicity Neutralization (RNA Foci Disruption)
therapeuticGoalDescription: Restore normal RNA-binding protein function by disrupting pathogenic RNA-protein complexes without necessarily degrading the RNA.
molecularDefect: Expanded repeat RNAs sequester essential RNA-binding proteins.
diseaseMechanism: Toxic RNA forms nuclear foci that trap proteins such as MBNL, leading to widespread splice abnormalities.
